1. Rajveer Kaur W/o Jogendra Singh, Aged About 42 Years,
 R/o 4-Lc-A, Tehsil Vijaynagar, District Sriganganagar.
2. Sarwan Kumar S/o Santudas, Aged About 33 Years, R/o  W N 3 H N, 593 Shaktinagar, District Sriganganagar.

----Petitioners  Versus 1. The State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. Niru Sharma W/o Late Shri Tarachand, R/o Ward No 9,
 Jaitsar, Tehsil Vijaynagar, District Sriganganagar.
----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Anirudh Bhati For Respondent(s) : Mr. Narendra Singh, PP
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MUKESH RAJPUROHIT Order 08/08/2025 1.

It is contended that upon compromise arrived at between the parties, the learned court below vide order dated 12.12.2024 verified the compromise between the parties for the offences under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 477-A and 120-B of IPC.

2. Learned counsel for the parties have placed reliance on a decision of Supreme Court in case of Gian Singh V/s. State of Punjab Anr. [(2012) 10 SCC 303].
3. In view of compromise arrived at between the parties as well as the aforesaid order dated 12.12.2024 of the learned court below and applying the ratio in decision of Gian Singh (supra), I deem it just and proper to invoke inherent powers of this Court under Section 528 BNSS (Section 482 Cr.P.C.).
[2025:RJ-JD:35540] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-3555/2025]
5.
